cues: Blue vitriol, nilathotha, is copper sulphate pentahydrate.
It is made by dissolving copper oxide or carbonate in warm dilute sulphuric acid, or industrially by blowing air through scrap copper in the acid.
Its structure is not five loose waters: four are bonded to the copper ion and the fifth is hydrogen bonded to the sulphate.
